title: TopoViewer mapper document
description: Maps Grafana or operational telemetry metrics to TopoViewer objects and runtime overlays.

$schema.description: Optional URI of the mapper JSON Schema used by editors and validation tools.

rules.description: Human-friendly mapper authoring rules. Rules compile to canonical mappings at runtime.

mappings.description: Canonical metric-to-object mapping rules. Prefer rules for hand-authored mapper YAML unless the advanced shape is needed.

identity.description: Optional source identity filter applied before mapping telemetry samples.

sourceIdLabel.description: Telemetry label carrying the source identity.

severityPalette.description: Optional severity color palette used by severity-driven runtime overlays.

severityPaletteEntry.description: Severity color. Use a string shorthand or a mapping when label/accent color should differ from the main overlay color.

color.description: Main overlay color for lines, borders, backgrounds, outlines, and status markers.

accent.description: Text/accent color for labels derived from this severity.

metric.description: Grafana data-frame metric name to match.

select.description: TopoViewer selector or object kind, such as link, linkDirection, node, node[labels.role = "pe"], path, region, layer, or graph.

join.description: Telemetry label carrying the selected object's ID, or a linkDirection join object with link and direction labels. Omit for selector-wide rules.

value.description: Short value semantic. Supported values include percent, utilizationPercent, up, errorsTotal, latencyMs, lossPercent, capacityPercent, bps, and health.

states.description: State names mapped to simple value expressions. Examples: down: "==0", busy: ">=70", saturated: ">=90".

additionalProperties.description: Value expression that activates the named mapper state.

style.description: Runtime style by state. style.default applies first; style.<state> overrides when the matching states.<state> expression is true.

additionalProperties.description: TopoViewer style patch applied for the named mapper state.

metric.description: Grafana data-frame metric name to match.

conditions.description: Conditional runtime style rules evaluated after the base overlay. Use this for selector-like dynamic style changes from telemetry values.

target.description: Topology object kind and resolver used by a canonical mapping.

kind.description: TopoViewer object kind affected by the metric.

resolver.description: Rules for resolving telemetry labels to stable TopoViewer object identities.

by.description: How telemetry labels resolve to TopoViewer objects.

metricLabel.description: Telemetry label used as the primary join value.

linkMetricLabel.description: Telemetry label carrying the parent link ID for linkDirection joins.

directionMetricLabel.description: Telemetry label carrying sourceToTarget or targetToSource for linkDirection joins.

key.description: TopoViewer label or data key used by label/data resolvers.

sourceLabel.description: Telemetry label carrying source node ID for endpoint matching.

targetLabel.description: Telemetry label carrying target node ID for endpoint matching.

selector.description: TopoViewer selector used by selector resolver.

objectIds.description: Explicit TopoViewer object IDs for static object matching.

link.description: Telemetry label carrying the parent TopoViewer link ID.

direction.description: Telemetry label carrying sourceToTarget or targetToSource.

value.description: Data-frame field selection and semantic interpretation for a mapping value.

field.description: Data-frame field to read. Defaults to the sample value.

as.description: Semantic interpretation of the metric value.

thresholds.description: Optional severity thresholds evaluated against the mapped value.

info.description: Value at which informational severity begins.

warning.description: Value at which warning severity begins.

error.description: Value at which error severity begins.

direction.description: Whether severity increases above or below each threshold.

overlay.description: Visual overlay behavior applied after a metric resolves to topology objects.

lineColorBySeverity.description: Color link or path lines using the resolved severity palette.

lineWidthBySeverity.description: Increase link or path line width according to resolved severity.

sourceArrowColorBySeverity.description: Color source arrow markers using the resolved severity palette.

targetArrowColorBySeverity.description: Color target arrow markers using the resolved severity palette.

outlineBySeverity.description: Apply a severity-colored outline to compatible topology objects.

statusMarker.description: Display a compact status marker using the resolved severity color.

backgroundColorBySeverity.description: Color compatible object backgrounds using the resolved severity palette.

borderColorBySeverity.description: Color compatible object borders using the resolved severity palette.

badgeLabel.description: Badge label template rendered on compatible target objects.

label.description: Runtime label template rendered for the resolved target.

propagateToLayerMembers.description: Apply a layer-targeted overlay to the objects that belong to the resolved layer.

style.description: Explicit TopoViewer style patch applied to every object resolved by the mapping.

id.description: Optional stable condition identifier for diagnostics and reviews.

style.description: TopoViewer style patch applied when the condition matches. String values may use mapper templates such as {{ value }}, {{ value | round }}, {{ value | bps }}, {{ severity }}, {{ metric }}, {{ target.id }}, {{ label.name }}, and {{ field.name }}.

condition.description: All specified condition fields must match for the style patch to apply.

severity.description: Required resolved severity for this condition to match.

scalarCondition.description: Comparison operators evaluated against the mapped scalar value.

eq.description: Match when the value equals this scalar.

ne.description: Match when the value does not equal this scalar.

gt.description: Match when the value is greater than this number.

gte.description: Match when the value is greater than or equal to this number.

lt.description: Match when the value is less than this number.

lte.description: Match when the value is less than or equal to this number.

contains.description: Match when the string representation contains this text.

exists.description: Match according to whether the value exists.

keyedCondition.description: Comparison operators evaluated against one telemetry label or data-frame field.

key.description: Telemetry label or field key to test.

eq.description: Match when the keyed value equals this scalar.

ne.description: Match when the keyed value does not equal this scalar.

gt.description: Match when the keyed value is greater than this number.

gte.description: Match when the keyed value is greater than or equal to this number.

lt.description: Match when the keyed value is less than this number.

lte.description: Match when the keyed value is less than or equal to this number.

contains.description: Match when the keyed string contains this text.

exists.description: Match according to whether the keyed value exists.
